qc.label_under_test: the English verbs 'install', 'inject' or 'implant' (putting something into a machine, program or body), any tense; not other verbs after 'can' or 'to' (read, review, browse) and not the nouns 'installation' or 'injection'

neighbours.label: A verb of fitting or swapping a part in repair or assembly steps (install, insert, replace, fit, attach), esp. after 'and'; weaker for install used figuratively, and not for inject
fire: Remove the two screws and replace the worn brake pads with new ones.
Drain the old oil, unscrew the filter and install the new one by hand.
Lift out the dead battery and insert a fresh one, making sure the terminals face up.
Slide the bearing onto the shaft and fit the retaining clip into its groove.
Clean the bracket thoroughly and attach it to the frame with the supplied bolts.
Pull the cracked screen away from the housing and replace it with the new panel.
Open the side panel of the computer and install the memory module in the empty slot.
Cut the old hose off at the clamp and attach the new length to the radiator.
quiet: The plumber came to look at the old boiler in the basement.
Remove the two screws and inspect the worn brake pads for any cracks.
Drain the old oil, unscrew the filter and dispose of it at a recycling center.
Lift out the dead battery and wipe the terminals dry with a clean cloth.
Slide the bearing off the shaft and measure the groove with a caliper.
Clean the bracket thoroughly and leave it on the bench to dry overnight.
Pull the cracked screen away from the housing and photograph the damage for your records.
Open the side panel of the computer and blow the dust out of the empty slot.
